package telegram

import (
	"context"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

type deliveryStoreStub struct {
	delivery domain.TelegramDelivery
	sentID   int64
	sent     bool
}

func (*deliveryStoreStub) EnqueueDelivery(context.Context, string, string, string, time.Time) error {
	return nil
}
func (stub *deliveryStoreStub) ClaimDelivery(_ context.Context, token string, _, _ time.Time) (domain.TelegramDelivery, bool, error) {
	stub.delivery.ClaimToken = token
	stub.delivery.Attempts++
	return stub.delivery, true, nil
}
func (stub *deliveryStoreStub) MarkDeliverySent(_ context.Context, _, _ string, remoteID int64, _ time.Time) error {
	stub.sent, stub.sentID = true, remoteID
	return nil
}
func (*deliveryStoreStub) RetryDelivery(context.Context, string, string, string, time.Time, time.Time) error {
	return nil
}
func (*deliveryStoreStub) BlockDelivery(context.Context, string, string, string, time.Time) error {
	return nil
}

type senderStub struct{}

func (senderStub) SendText(context.Context, int64, string) (int64, error) { return 77, nil }

func TestDeliveryWorkerMarksAcknowledgedTelegramMessage(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	store := &deliveryStoreStub{delivery: domain.TelegramDelivery{
		SourceMessageID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", StudentID: telegramStudentID,
		ChatID: 42, Body: "Ответ учителя", Status: "pending", CreatedAt: now,
	}}
	worker := DeliveryWorker{
		Store: store, Sender: senderStub{}, Tokens: tokenStub{value: telegramCode}, Clock: clockStub{value: now},
		LeaseTTL: time.Minute, RetryBaseDelay: time.Second, RetryMaxDelay: time.Minute,
	}
	claimed, err := worker.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, claimed)
	require.True(t, store.sent)
	require.Equal(t, int64(77), store.sentID)
}
